anchors.description: Standard US bed pillow (20x26 in = 0.51x0.66 m) at the head of the bed against the back wall, covered by the burgundy comforter; endpoints are the visible fabric surface points near the two ends of the pillow's long axis (the dome end-to-end span along the headboard/wall).
anchors.visible_evidence: Two dome-shaped mounds of the comforter at the bed head against the bright back wall; the right mound is fully visible: the V-notch wall junction between the two pillows at about x=300 and the flank meeting the wall at about x=500, with the dome peak near (410,176) (traced from bright wall to dark fabric in the original frame).
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Pillow is under the comforter, so the visible dome is pillow plus drape; the long axis could be the 26-in (0.66 m) or 20-in (0.51 m) side depending on pillow orientation, and the size class (standard vs queen) is uncertain; could conceivably be a folded duvet rather than a pillow.
